verdict.rationale: Buzz's core model treats automations as git-style patches with review and merge decisions baked into the channel (buzz-gh-1, buzz-gh-5), and the CLI exposes workflow trigger/approve commands (buzz-docs-8) plus repo protection rules (buzz-docs-7), giving some versioning and review capability for automation-like workflows. However, there is no explicit evidence of a 'rollback' mechanism for workflows/automations specifically, nor of automation-specific version history beyond generic git patch review. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/undo functionality for workflows, and dedicated versioning UI/CLI for automations distinct from general code patches.
